hero.title: Privacy Policy
hero.subtitle: Your privacy is important to us. This policy explains how we collect, use, and protect your information when you use NYALTX.

content:
# Last updated: January 2, 2024

Information We Collect

We collect information you provide directly to us, such as when you create an account, use our services, or contact us for support. This may include:

* Wallet addresses and transaction data
*
* Usage data and analytics
*
* Communication preferences

How We Use Your Information

We use the information we collect to provide, maintain, and improve our services, process transactions, and communicate with you about your account and our services.

Data Security

We implement appropriate technical and organizational measures to protect your personal information against unauthorized access, alteration, disclosure, or destruction.

Contact Us

If you have any questions about this Privacy Policy, please contact us at privacy\@nyaltx.pro
